about_the_game:
Field school is a comedic narrative game inspired by the absurdity of archaeological dig sites. :O

Meet a cast of characters!

Greater than or equal to 6 whole characters to meet and be socially awkward to!

Do some real archaeology!

For example, fetching coffee for people.

Unwravel the secrets of the past!?!?!?!!?!??

??!?!?!!?!?!?!!!?!!??:S!?!?!?

Listen to the radio!

Our archaeologist said that you aren't actually allowed to do that so much on a dig site but I really wanted to make a radio so you can do that to if you like. Apparently it can drown out people saying things like "Help! I've fallen into this pit of rich rich history!" or something.

Tune in to DirtFM for more on the topic.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
